scope: Numerical consistency and definitional boundary audit across mfrmpy 0.2.0, mfrmr 0.3.0 (development), TAM 4.3.25, and ACER ConQuest 5.47.5 Professional on synthetic RSM, incomplete linked PCM, 10-replicate small-sample Monte Carlo, and 7 boundary/low-df scenarios.
definitional_and_implementation_findings: MML SEs: ConQuest 5.47.5 rejects stderr=full and uses stderr=empirical for full observed-information SEs on free coordinates (matching mfrmpy 0.2.0 and mfrmr 0.3.0 across all 18/18 free parameters in S1+S2 to 0.000 at 3 dp), whereas ConQuest stderr=quick and TAM::tam.se() return diagonal curvature 1/sqrt(diag(I)) (~20% smaller on correlated Rater levels).

ConQuest constrained (*) level SEs: On sum-to-zero derived levels (e.g. T3*, R4*, C3*), ConQuest 5.47.5 repeats the preceding parameter's SE (T3*=T2=0.096, R4*=R3=0.121; S2 C3*=C2=0.127, R4*=R3=0.179) and omits Step_3* SE rather than propagating the sum-to-zero Jacobian sqrt(diag(J I^{-1} J^T)) (mfrmpy & mfrmr: T3=0.099, R4=0.120; S2 C3=0.128, R4=0.184).

MML Person EAP reliability: mfrmpy (population basis) and TAM::EAP.rel compute Var_pop(EAP)/(Var_pop(EAP)+mean(SD^2)) (0.861 on S1); ConQuest EAP/PV RELIABILITY computes Var_sample(EAP)/sigma^2_prior (0.796 on S1, 0.664 on S2); mfrmr 0.3.0 summarize_precision_basis currently applies (Var-mean(SD^2))/Var to Person as well.

ConQuest MML fit & EAP scoring: ConQuest computes case EAP/PosteriorSD via Monte Carlo posterior draws (p_nodes=50000 gives ~1e-3 MC RMSE vs deterministic quadrature) and computes Weighted/Unweighted MNSQ over 5 random Plausible Value draws, whereas mfrmpy and mfrmr evaluate deterministic Rasch residuals at EAP.

MML quadrature default in mfrmpy: mfrmpy defaults to quad_points=15 for desktop compatibility, which fails the finer-grid sensitivity check on 12-rating-per-person polytomous Specified intervals; passing quad_points=31+ (matching mfrmr 0.3.0 default) passes sensitivity gates and matches converged integrals.

Conditional Bias p-values: Bias Size and SE match (<1.8e-5), while Prob. differs by ~0.010-0.015 because mfrmpy reports 1-df conditional LR chi-square p-values (unit_weight_conditional_lr_v1) whereas mfrmr reports FACETS Student-t (df=N-1).

Boundary & low-df safeguards: Both mfrmpy 0.2.0 and mfrmr 0.3.0 withhold ZSTD when df<1, refuse zero-count internal categories, flag unobserved boundary categories and disconnected MML cohorts, and find the exact same finite interior MLE (R4=3.446) when a single centered facet level is all-minimum under fixed N(0,1) MML; mfrmpy additionally resolves the JMLE extreme-person |eta|>23 endpoint limit analytically, masks N=1 zero-df free JMLE mean squares, and leaves RealSE as NaN when Infit is unavailable.
